scope: Authored same-build rapid-boat compatibility candidate. Static PE checks and synthetic instruction-model tests only.
observed_static: Rapid FixedUpdate calls native Exit at RVA0x44c1ce. Native Exit0x545920 does not emit opcode31 False.
The ordinary non-rapid exit path can emit31 False. The S2C31 False consumer ignores release.
The replacement instance therefore needs a remote retire/reseed when a guarded rapid release arrives.
authored_compatibility: Redirect only that call to a new RX section. Preserve all existing unwind entries and add the wrapper entry.
Capture local actor/vehicle, call original Exit exactly once, recheck local identity and cleared vehicle, and require TCP connectivity.
For the shipped rapid index0, allocate a managed UTF16 string through IL2CPP and send31#GUID#False#0 through the original TCP sender.
The instance retires only other viewers, delays reseeding by at least two Unity frames, and filters transform delivery while reseeding.

manifest.scope: Same-build compatibility candidate, static/offline validation only; original server parity not proven.
manifest.source_variant: same build with reviewed wardrobe loop fix only
limitations: Candidate wrapper has not run in Unity/IL2CPP. Static checks do not prove runtime delivery or timing.
Shipped rapid index0 only; nonzero manager index fails closed after native exit.
Extra singleton getter before native exit is an authored compatibility step; current local actor identity is checked again after exit.
The managed string is allocated by exported IL2CPP API on the original managed game thread and passed immediately as TcpSend's managed argument; no raw allocation or manual GC field write.
Native exceptions propagate through generated unwind metadata; no new exception handler swallows original failures.
Sending False requires the separately implemented server remote refresh, since original S2C31 False is ignored.

synthetic_checks.scope: Pure Python integer-instruction semantic model of only new wrapper code with synthetic data/native stubs; no original game code executed.

independent_review.kind: static source/PE/native-evidence review by a separate worker
independent_review.findings: No high-confidence ABI, relocation, field-write or unwind defect found in the reviewed candidate. An output-path overwrite issue in --spec was found and fixed.
coverage: Both accepted input variants reproduced in memory
All seven native call targets checked
Original138029 runtime-function entries preserved plus one
independent_review.limitation: A review result is not proof of native execution, GC safety or server/client timing.

path_guards: All three copy tools reject existing/installed/source output paths; manifests require a new JSON destination. Five CLI tests exercise rejection with synthetic inputs.
remaining_unknowns: Windows loader/unwinder and live IL2CPP garbage collector have not exercised the wrapper.
Additional helper calls can throw before the original caller continuation; native unwind metadata propagates rather than swallows exceptions.
Two-frame remote teardown/reseed sequencing, animation state and transform races require future runtime validation.
This is a new preservation compatibility policy, not a recovered original server operation.
